clauses.reason: The command that all executive departments and independent establishments 'shall be closed on January 2, 2007' is limited to that one day by its own terms and was spent when that day ended. First end: 2007-01-02, inclusive; the actor is EO 13421 itself.

The exception for offices and installations that the agency heads determine should remain open qualifies the closing in section 1, which applies only to January 2, 2007. It has no object after that date. First end: 2007-01-02, inclusive; the actor is EO 13421 itself.

research_rationale:
Section 1 closes all executive departments, independent establishments and governmental agencies on one named day, January 2, 2007, as a mark of respect for a former President, and brings that day within the scope of Executive Order 11582 and 5 U.S.C. 5546 and 6103(b) for pay and leave. Section 2 is an exception to the closing. Both clauses are tied by their own terms to that single day. A search of held order texts for the number 13421 finds only the order itself, so no later order revokes or supersedes it. The end date is the closing day itself, recorded inclusive; the exclusive reading would place the end when the day begins.

savings.reason: No saving clause appears in the order. Pay and leave treatment for January 2, 2007 accrued on that day and is not a continuing command of the order.
